note: TWENTY ONE TV followed-profile segment (App\Support\Caster\FollowedScripts): an intro naming the profile ({name}, nominative: the display name or 'ein Nostr-Kollege'; self_intros when the profile is Markus' own; the dated_ variants, with {when} = 'Im März zweitausenddreiundzwanzig', for a note older than followed.dated_after_hours), then Markus' retelling and reaction by the league voice.
